title: Beyond Prediction-Set Size: Quantifying Conformal Uncertainty through Credal Geometry
abstract: arXiv:2602.01667v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Prediction-set size offers a coarse summary of conformal uncertainty. We develop a richer perspective through the geometry of credal sets: families of probability distributions compatible with conformal prediction (CP) regions. We establish this representation for split CP, extending a correspondence recently identified for full CP. Building on this representation, we derive analytical characterisations and exact algorithms for several widely used credal uncertainty measures, reducing potentially exponential computations to linear time after sorting the conformal p-values. We further unify several of these measures with classical conformal summaries by integrating set-size penalties based on Tsallis entropies across error levels. We also prove an impossibility theorem: for common split-conformal regression constructions, uncertainty summaries of the induced credal sets cannot distinguish between inputs. translated_title: 超越预测集大小：通过信度集合几何量化共形不确定性
translated_abstract: 预测集大小只是对共形不确定性的一种粗略概括。我们通过信度集合的几何视角发展出一种更丰富的刻画方式：信度集合是与共形预测（CP）区域相容的概率分布族。我们为分离式共形预测建立了这一表示，扩展了最近在全共形预测中发现的对应关系。基于该表示，我们为几种广泛使用的信度不确定性度量推导出解析刻画和精确算法，在共形 p 值排序之后，可将潜在的指数级计算降低至线性时间。我们进一步通过引入基于 Tsallis 熵的、跨越不同误差水平的集合大小惩罚，将其中若干度量与经典共形摘要统一起来。我们还证明了一个不可能性定理：对于常见的分离式共形回归构造，所诱导信度集合的不确定性摘要无法区分不同的输入。分类实验……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出以信度集合几何作为超越预测集大小的共形不确定性量化新视角，为多种信度不确定性度量给出解析刻画与排序后线性时间的精确算法，通过 Tsallis 熵集合大小惩罚将其与经典共形摘要统一，并证明了常见分离式共形回归中不确定性摘要无法区分输入的不可能性定理。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a credal-set-geometry perspective for quantifying conformal uncertainty beyond prediction-set size, providing analytical characterisations and linear-time exact algorithms for common credal uncertainty measures, unifying them with classical conformal summaries via Tsallis-entropy-based set-size penalties, and proving an impossibility theorem that these summaries cannot distinguish inputs in standard split-conformal regression.
